baseline_statement: Pre-repair historical baseline. These records are exported unchanged from the live store. They are the output of a derivation whose merge stage performed zero merges across every round, whose proposer/critic debate deferred its disagreements to the review queue rather than settling them, and whose open disputes are still open. No criterion was improved, corrected or tidied during export; corrected records belong to a later version published with a diff.

bounds.counts: registered criteria carrying a numeric bound whose basis is a cited claim, a bound restating a task constraint, and no bound at all

collapsed_away_now.counts: registered rules whose attribute a collapse merged away

collapses.counts: collapse records; each merged several registrations of one quantity into one attribute reading every route

comparable_from_fields.counts: registered criteria all four rubric facets can be read off without reading prose; the applicability gap is schema-wide, so this is zero while no attribute records applicability as a field

deferred_now.counts: registered rules held out of the latest set because a capability they need was not run

expert_decisions.counts: `hd_` records; an expert decision needs a person at a terminal

machine_adjudications.counts: items resolved by software with no person; recorded as `agent_verdict`, never as an expert approval

matching_facet_gaps.counts: registered criteria whose records do not answer one of the four recovery-rubric facets from fields alone; the cards name the absence per criterion

pool_lineages.counts: distinct `cri_` lineages the pool ever held

promoted_pool_items.counts: pool lineages whose final state is `promoted`; each wrote one attribute and one rule into the registry

proposals_added_to_pool.counts: pool lineages created by the propose stage, over every round in this task

pruned_pool_items.counts: pool lineages that never reached the registry, by final state: withdrawn 38

registered_criteria.counts: distinct attribute ids in the registry, each paired with one rule id; this is the promoted pool items plus the criteria the adapter templates registered without entering the pool

registered_from_pool.counts: registered criteria whose attribute a pool promotion wrote

registered_from_templates.counts: registered criteria an adapter template wrote directly, bypassing the pool

registry_versions.counts: attribute and rule *versions*, not criteria; a second version is a revision of one criterion, not another criterion

review_queue.counts: review items raised against this task, by state

scoring_now.counts: rules in rules@v3, the latest confirmed set

unresolved_disputes.counts: open review items raised because a proposer and a critic still disagreed after one revision

recovery_comparison_set.statement: The derived set for a recovery mapping: every registered criterion whose quantity is not already carried by another registered criterion. Pruned pool items are in the lifecycle section and are not derived criteria. Nothing here is shaped by any knowledge of the sealed historical list.

task.objective_text: Identify a single orally administered agent that concurrently engages the stated tumour-microenvironment targets (CSF1R, VEGFR1, VEGFR2, VEGFR3, FGFR1), with a pharmacological profile suitable for clinical development
